create_X86InductorQuantizer: create an X86InductorQuantizer instance to annotate a PyTorch FX GraphModule for x86 int8 quantization
build_quantization_config: build a default x86 inductor quantization config with per-tensor uint8 activation and per-channel int8 weight specs
annotate_model_with_quantizer: annotate a PyTorch FX GraphModule with conv2d and linear fusion patterns for int8 quantization
set_global_quantization_config: set a global quantization config on X86InductorQuantizer to apply uniform quantization across all supported operators
set_operator_type_config: set a per-operator-type quantization config on X86InductorQuantizer to customize quantization for specific operator patterns
